options.name: conversion_host_id
options.description: Identifier for the conversion host where the conversion will be performed. This is used to track and manage the conversion process.

options.name: esxi_hostname
options.description: Hostname or IP address of the ESXi host where the virtual machine is located.

options.name: vcenter_cluster
options.description: Name of the cluster in vCenter where the VM resides.

options.name: vcenter_datacenter
options.description: Name of the datacenter in vCenter where the VM resides.

options.name: vcenter_hostname
options.description: Hostname or IP address of the VMware vCenter server.

options.name: vcenter_username
options.description: Username to authenticate with the VMware vCenter server.

options.name: vddk_libdir
options.description: Directory path containing the VMware VDDK library files. This is required for virt-v2v to access the VMware infrastructure.

options.name: vddk_thumbprint
options.description: SSL thumbprint of the VMware vCenter server for verification. This ensures secure communication with the vCenter server.

options.name: vm_name
options.description: Name of the virtual machine to be converted.
